Role Description
We are seeking a Principal Engineer to act as the most senior hands‑on technical expert for our leading Risk Screening platform. This role partners closely with architecture, service, product, and engineering teams to ensure that agreed designs are implemented to the highest technical and operational standards.
A core focus of the role is ownership of the system’s non‑functional characteristics, including end‑to‑end latency, cloud scalability, resilience, and the effective handling of large and growing data sets.
The Principal Engineer ensures these qualities are deliberately designed for, correctly implemented, and continuously validated in production.
Rather than owning architecture in isolation, the Principal Engineer is the expert implementor and problem solver: translating architectural intent into robust, performant, and secure production systems. You will use your knowledge of AWS Services and Java development to tackle the hardest technical challenges, proactively identify operational risks, and provide deep technical guidance that sets the highest standard across all engineering teams working on the product.
This is the most senior individual contributor role with broad influence, focused on technical excellence, delivery confidence, and long‑term sustainability.
Technical Leadership & Implementation Excellence
• Act as the senior‑most technical authority for implementation within the Risk Screening platform, ensuring designs are realised accurately and pragmatically.
• Work in close partnership with enterprise and solution architects to validate designs, challenge assumptions, and guide effective development approaches by the engineering teams.
• Lead the implementation of the most complex and business‑critical changes, setting the standard for quality, performance, and maintainability.
• Provide hands‑on expertise in Java‑based systems, including concurrency, performance tuning, memory management, and API design.
Non‑Functional Ownership & System Performance
• Take a leading role in defining, implementing, and validating non‑functional requirements, including system latency, throughput, scalability, and reliability.
• Drive solutions for cloud scaling and capacity management, ensuring the platform performs predictably under variable and peak loads.
• Provide deep expertise in working with large databases and data stores, including performance optimisation, data access patterns, and operational scaling.
Problem Solving & Technical Decision Support
• Solve the most complex and ambiguous technical problems, particularly those spanning multiple components or teams.

Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Department Overview
At CRFS (A Motorola Solutions Company), we create the world’s most advanced technology for monitoring the radio spectrum. We are looking for a highly capable, hands-on Test and Validation Engineer (RF Systems) to join our team in Cambridge and lead the verification of systems that keep people safer everywhere. In this role, you will be instrumental in turning cutting-edge prototypes into mission-ready realities.
Job Description
The Role
This is a high-impact, hands-on role at the heart of our Systems Engineering team, serving as the vital link between prototype development and mission-ready product release. You will balance structured V-model verification with rapid "fail-fast" testing to ensure our world-class RF systems are robust, reliable, and technically superior. If you take pride in technical problem-solving and love the challenge of uncovering emergent issues in complex, integrated hardware and software, this is the role for you.
Key Responsibilities
•
Verification Strategy: Define and execute system-level validation plans that balance rigorous testing with delivery speed to ensure risks are retired early in the development cycle.
•
Prototype Testing: Plan and conduct functional, performance, and stress testing in both lab and field environments to feed critical results back into design decisions.
•
System Integration: Validate complete systems, ensuring that integrated hardware, RF, software, and mechanical elements perform seamlessly as intended.
•
Fault-Finding & Root Cause: Lead investigations into complex technical issues across multiple domains, supporting fault-finding from the embedded level to mechanical integration.
•
Infrastructure Improvement: Develop and maintain high-quality test rigs, fixtures, and automated procedures to improve the repeatability and efficiency of our validation activities.
•
Documentation & Reporting: Produce clear, evidence-based documentation that supports technical reviews, NPI handover, and engineering changes.
Basic Requirements
What We’re Looking For

Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
Our Philosophy
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people.
Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.
Our Culture
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

Underwriting

1
What Is the Opportunity?
Business Insurance helps companies in the UK and Ireland identify, prepare for and mitigate risks by offering a broad array of industry-specific, combined property and casualty insurance solutions to customers. This includes SME solutions traded directly, Commercial Accounts traded via brokers, and Corporate Solutions to FTSE 350 Risk Managed companies.
We're looking for a driven Senior Property & Casualty Underwriter to join our high-performing Birmingham Branch here at Travelers. In this role, you'll take the lead on developing and managing new business submissions, quotes, and binds, working strategically alongside broker partners to develop relationships and craft smart insurance solutions that genuinely meet customer needs. You'll bring sharp analytical thinking to evaluate and manage risk across your portfolio, with the confidence to negotiate terms, close deals, and thrive in competitive markets, driving sustainable growth and profitability.
Travelers Europe currently offers flexibility to employees who wish to work on a hybrid basis in accordance with our Hybrid Work Arrangements Policy. This entails full time employees working three days a week in the office and two days at home (or pro rata for part-time employees). This policy may be changed at the Company’s discretion.
What Will You Do?
• Manage the profitability, growth, and retention of an assigned book of business primarily comprised of moderate to complex accounts across all our products.
• Underwrite and skillfully negotiate moderate to complex risks to minimise risk and maximise profitability, including Mid Term Adjustments (MTAs).
• Proactively manage your portfolio, ensuring key performance indicators are consistently achieved and you actively target new business and retention.
• Identify and take corrective action based on individual risk characteristics identified through Portfolio Management to actively manage your portfolio of risks.
• Identify and capture opportunities to write additional lines of business using knowledge of products, risk characteristics and appetite.
• Proactively utilise various technology platforms to quote and bind risk efficiently.
• Prepare, lead and present Underwriting Reviews for individual policies or portfolios/schemes and manage action points.
• Cultivate and maintain relationships with internal partners within the business unit and across the enterprise to identify cross-selling opportunities.
• Foster and maintain relationships with brokers by phone, email or other communication channels to market and sell Travelers products with a goal of writing and retaining accounts consistent with our risk appetite. Must be able to travel to meetings.
• Develop and execute pipeline plans and support the renewal team in the retention of business that aligns with the team’s sales plans to drive success working in partnership with the sales team.
• Train and mentor less experienced underwriters.
• Support and collaboration for more junior members of the team, including referrals.
• Perform other duties as assigned.
What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?
• A Levels or similar qualification.
• Knowledge: Deep knowledge of products, the regulatory environment, and the local insurance market.
• Analytical/Critical thinking: Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to underwrite, market products, identify financial challenges, and analyse available information to make decisions in alignment with our risk appetite.

• Leadership: Experience coaching and mentoring others.
• Industry / Competitor Analysis: Review competitor press releases and industry trade press for helpful insights, linking key themes together and identifying applicability to team strategies.
• Project Management: Participate in and/or lead projects that involves complex analysis and implementation of non-complex, routine business and regulatory changes relating to the enhancement, maintenance or introduction of new products.
What is a Must Have?
• Strong experience of underwriting, product knowledge, financial analysis, or risk assessment experience.
What Is in It for You?
• Private Medical Insurance: On commencement of employment, you are eligible for single cover provided by Travelers, with the option to add cover for your dependents, at your expense through payroll deduction.
• Retirement: Travelers will make a core contribution of a percentage of salary to your Pension Plan. Additionally, if you decide to contribute to the plan, you will receive an increased company contribution.
• Holiday Entitlement: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 25 days holiday entitlement annually, plus the opportunity to purchase additional days to allow for up to a total of 35 holidays per year.

Better content. Better products. And better careers.
Working in Tech, Product or Data at Sky is about building the next and the new. From broadband to broadcast, streaming to mobile, Sky Q to Sky Glass, we never stand still. We optimise and innovate.
We turn big ideas into the products, content and services millions of people love.
And we do it all right here at Sky.
The purpose of this role is to oversee the end-to-end content operations process for the reception, enrichment, finalisation and distribution of live content to be published on the new Sky Live Events platform.  This role provides support to the content operation and monitoring of all systems involved in the Live Event delivery process from planning to distribution.
You will have control of the end-to-end systems for the reception and finalisation of the live feeds and their distribution to the publishing points. It will be your responsibility to ensure that all aspects of the system are functioning as expected and to take action to resolve or escalate in the event of an issue. This system delivers Live content internationally and communication of changes or alterations to events will be your responsibility ensuring that all platforms are in sync across the group and that the customer receives the best possible experience.
What you'll do
Scheduling and Resource Planning:
•
Using the schedule of events, you will configure the components of the system from end – end. Checking and verifying that the metadata is correct for the events and managing any last-minute changes to the schedule
•
You will ensure that all monitoring systems are running and all parts of the event chain are ready for the event to start
Monitoring and Control:
•
Once the events are underway you will monitor the live event content and all systems related to the publishing of the event and be ready to react should any problems occur
•
You will intervene and provide a solution or escalate to a relevant team if necessary
Content Management:
•
Safeguarding the customer experience by ensuring that the content has the correct graphics/title etc and taking corrective action.
Communication Hub:
•
As a central point of contact for the platform you communicate with all stakeholders to inform them of any platform issues
•
Should an event be delayed or extended you will communicate with all international stakeholders so that action may be taken to extend or close an event
What you'll bring
•
Highly effective, positive and influential communication style; demonstration of excellent people skills, communication skills, and coaching within your current team
•
Knowledge of Sky’s broadcast chain and platforms
•
Ability to prioritise problems and ensure the best customer experience
•
Ability to resolve complex problems or problems where precedent may not exist
•
Consistently demonstrate strong team behaviours
•
Work provides a significant positive impact on the team and/or the business
•
The best examples of the required behaviours and Sky values in action
•
Achieves exceptional results in a way that inspires others to do it better
Shift Pattern
You will be required to work from Monday to Sunday various shifts (depending on business objectives) for example: 7-day fortnight, Week 1 - Mon, Tue, Fri, Sat, Sun / Week 2 - Wed, Thu 12-hour days with hour break
The rewards
There's one thing people can't stop talking about when it comes to #LifeAtSky: the perks. Here’s a taster:
•
Sky Q, for the TV you love all in one place
•
The magic of Sky Glass at an exclusive rate
•
A generous pension package
•
Private healthcare
•
Discounted mobile and broadband
•
A wide range of Sky VIP rewards and experiences
Team overview
Content technology and innovation
Our Content Technology and Innovation team delivers high-quality content to homes, customer devices, businesses and commercial partners across our European markets. With over 2500 colleagues from around the world, we combine our strategic insights, engineering know-how and operational excellence to use the most innovative technologies to create and distribute our award-winning content!
Inclusion & how you'll work
We are a Disability Confident Employer, and welcome and encourage applications from all candidates. We will look to ensure a fair and consistent experience for all, and will make reasonable adjustments to support you where appropriate. Please flag any adjustments you need to your recruiter as early as you can.
Your office space
Our Osterley Campus is a 10-minute walk from Syon Lane train station. Or you can hop on one of our free shuttle buses that run to and from Osterley, Gunnersbury, Ealing Broadway and South Ealing tube stations. There are also plenty of bike shelters and showers.
On campus, you’ll find 13 subsidised restaurants, cafes, and a Waitrose. You can keep in shape at our subsidised gym, catch the latest shows and movies at our cinema, get your car washed, and even get pampered at our beauty salon.
We'd love to hear from you
Inventive, forward-thinking minds come together to work in Tech, Product and Data at Sky. It’s a place where you can explore what if, how far, and what next.
But better doesn’t stop at what we do, it’s how we do it, too. We embrace each other’s differences. We support our community and contribute to a sustainable future for our business and the planet.
If you believe in better, we’ll back you all the way.

About Us
At Aviva Investors, our expertise is in matching the right investment approach to each client’s unique needs. As the global asset management business of Aviva plc, we bring together our broad investment capabilities to deliver client-focused solutions worldwide. We are hiring for a Manager of Client Relationship Management to join the UK Insurance Clients team within the Insurance Distribution channel. This role is responsible for the leadership and oversight of the Client Relationship Manager (CRM) team, who deliver the day-to-day management and servicing of our internal and external Insurance clients across a range of asset classes. You will ensure a consistent, high-quality client experience, acting as the key escalation point for servicing matters and driving alignment across clients, processes, and teams.
Working closely with the Head of EMEA Insurance Client Relationship and our Client Relationship Directors (CRDs), you will play a key role in enabling CRDs to focus on commercial growth and strategic relationship development, by ensuring servicing delivery is efficient, proactive, and well-coordinated.
You will be a people leader and delivery-focused operator, motivated by improving how teams work, driving consistency of service, and resolving issues effectively. You will be comfortable operating across stakeholders and able to balance client needs, operational priorities, and commercial outcomes
Role Responsibilities
• Lead and manage the CRM team, setting clear expectations and ensuring consistent delivery of high-quality client servicing across all Insurance clients.
• Act as the primary escalation point for client servicing issues, ensuring timely resolution and effective coordination across stakeholders.
• Maintain oversight of client servicing delivery, ensuring proactive, consistent, and high-quality outcomes across mandates and asset classes.
• Drive alignment and continuous improvement of client servicing processes, embedding best practice and efficiency across the team.
• Build strong relationships across Aviva Investors, acting as a central coordination point for servicing-related matters.
• Oversee the execution and coordination of onboarding and mandate changes, ensuring appropriate governance and implementation.
• Maintain strong understanding of client requirements and ensure insights are reflected in servicing delivery.
• Support Client Relationship Directors by identifying and escalating commercial opportunities and ensuring a seamless end-to-end client experience that underpins retention and growth.
What we're looking for:
• Strong experience in asset management client servicing or relationship management, ideally supporting Insurance clients day-to-day.
• Solid understanding of investment products, asset classes, and the operational lifecycle of client mandates.
• Proven experience managing or coordinating teams, driving consistent delivery and accountability for service outcomes. Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and complex servicing requirements.
• Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, able to engage and influence across all levels.
• Relevant degree or equivalent experience; IMC (or equivalent) required and regulatory threshold competent.
In this role you’ll be ‘Certified’ under the Financial Conduct Authority / Prudential Regulation Authority’s Senior Managers and Certification Regime (SMCR). This means that we’ll need to complete some regulatory background checks on you before you take up your role and we’ll need to ask you some questions on an annual basis to make sure you remain ‘fit and proper’ and competent to carry out your role. We’ll provide training on what holding a SMCR role means when you join us and annually thereafter.
What you’ll get for this role:
Our purpose - with you today, for a better tomorrow – is a promise we make to our colleagues too. And one of the ways we live up to that promise is by investing in you. We have so much to offer when it comes to being an Aviva Investors colleague:
• Competitive salary (depending on skills, experience, and qualifications).
• Discretionary bonus opportunity - depending on individual performance and Aviva Investors’!
• Generous pension scheme - Aviva will contribute up to 14%, depending on what you put in.
• 29 days holiday plus bank holidays, and you can choose to buy or sell up to 5 days!
• Aviva-funded Private Medical Benefit to help you get expert support when you need it.
• Make your money go further with up to 40% discount on Aviva products, and other retailer discounts.
• Up to £1,200 of free Aviva shares per year through our Matching Share Plan and share in the success of Aviva with our Save As You Earn scheme.
• Brilliantly supportive policies including parental and carer’s leave.
• Flexible benefits to suit you, including sustainability options such as cycle to work.
• Make a difference, be part of our Aviva Communities and use your 3 annual volunteering days to help others.
Aviva is for everyone:
We’re inclusive and welcome everyone – we want applications from all backgrounds and experiences. Excited but not sure you tick every box? Even if you don’t, we would still encourage you to apply. We also consider all forms of flexible working, including part time and job shares.
Most of our people are smart working – spending at least 50% of their time in our offices every week - combining the benefits of flexibility, with time together with colleagues. To find out more about working at Aviva, take a look here.
We’d love it if you could submit your application online but if you require an alternative method of applying, please email us at GlobalRecruitment@avivainvestors.com. Please ensure that you have attached an up-to-date CV and/or updated your professional profile on Workday as we cannot progress your application without this.

kla.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/search/job/new.description_excerpt:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
Group/Division
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The SPTS division provides advanced wafer processing solutions—including etch, deposition and vapor-based technologies—designed for R&D through high-volume production. With a global presence and strong customer support network, SPTS helps manufacturers across industries improve performance, yield and cost-efficiency. It also offers comprehensive service and spare parts through a worldwide network of service centers and qualified local agents.
What You'll Do
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
This role is accountable for the development and optimisation of plasma processes to achieve defined performance, quality, and yield objectives. Working within multidisciplinary teams, the role applies scientific and engineering principles to resolve technical challenges, enhance process capability, and support new product development and customer requirements.
As part of the plasma dicing team, the primary responsibilities of this position include developing plasma etch processes, processing customer wafers using etch demonstration equipment, and documenting the completed sample processing activities.
Additional responsibilities include providing customer technical support, preparing technical reports for internal and external stakeholders, generating intellectual property submissions, and supporting other business units as required.
Occasional domestic and international travel, including to the United States, may be required as part of this role to support customer installations and development activities. Occasional shift work may also be required. Certain roles at KLA may require permits, licenses or other approvals to access specific technologies, systems or information, and obtaining such approvals may form part of the assessment process for the role.
Key Responsibilities
Process Demonstrations
• Develop and demonstrate plasma etch processes to meet agreed specifications.
• Assess results using analytical equipment and relevant software tools.
• Perform process troubleshooting and root cause analysis.
• Provide regular updates to Product Management on demonstration and sample work.
• Build and maintain effective relationships with customers and the global KLA support network.
• Summarise findings through technical reports and presentations.
Process Development
• Develop and optimise processes across SPTS product platforms.
• Plan and execute work safely, efficiently, and to agreed timescales.
• Utilise endpoint detection techniques to enhance process control and performance.
• Conduct long-duration testing for new processes and equipment.
• Contribute to cross-functional projects supporting new products and technologies.
• Prepare technical reports to support patent applications, publications, and conferences.
Field Support
• Develop and optimise SPTS processes to meet customer requirements at customer sites.
• Provide factory-based technical support to field teams and customers.
• Establish and maintain strong customer relationships through effective technical support.
Qualifications and Experience
The successful candidate will have:
• A PhD, Master's degree, or Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, together with relevant industrial experience. Candidates with equivalent qualifications and hands-on semiconductor process engineering experience are also encouraged to apply.
• Experience of plasma etch processing within a semiconductor environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Experience with semiconductor metrology techniques.
• SEM experience would be advantageous, although training can be provided.
• Knowledge and practical experience of endpoint detection techniques.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• The ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
• Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
What We Offer
• 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
• Share scheme
• Contributory pension scheme
• Cash health plan
• Cycle to Work scheme
• Global bonus plan
• Employee rewards scheme
• Life assurance
Occasional domestic and international travel, including to the United States, may be required as part of this role to support customer installations and development activities. Occasional shift work may also be required. Certain roles at KLA may require permits, licenses or other approvals to access specific technologies, systems or information, and obtaining such approvals may form part of the assessment process for the role.
Minimum Qualifications
About KLA
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
Use of AI Statement
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.

Job Title
Europe & Middle East Content Localisation manager
Job Description
So, who are we?
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions — built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.
The bar is high — bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.
Join us at IG — the future gets built here.
Your team
Organic search is a core growth channel for IG. Our SEO team is responsible for making sure investors can find us, trust us and start their journey with us, and as we expand our presence across Europe, our websites are central to that. You'll join the team at an important moment, as we build out a dedicated European web presence and the content engine to go with it.
About this role
We're looking for a European Content & Localisation Manager to own how IG's content performs across our European& Middle Easr websites. You will decide what content is translated, what is tailored for a market and what is created locally, prioritise that work by search opportunity, and make sure it ranks and converts. You will also project-manage the content workstream of our migration to a new European website.
This role is based in our London office and reports into the SEO Lead. You will work day to day with our content editor and with Marketing, Compliance and commercial stakeholders, and alongside MarTech, who own the technical side of the migration. You'll be the person who thinks about our European websites as a whole: which content is relevant for which market, what can simply be translated, what needs real adaptation, and what to do first.
This is not a traditional SEO or editorial role. SEO experience is a plus, but what matters most is sound commercial judgement, strong project management and excellent language skills. Fluency in French or German is essential. We operate in a regulated industry, so experience in finance is a big plus.
What you'll do
• Own the European content roadmap, prioritising what gets localised, tailored or created by market based on search opportunity, commercial value and effort.
• Decide for each piece of content whether to translate, adapt or create locally, and set clear standards so these decisions are consistent and repeatable.
• Work with the content editor and other stakeholders to identify the content from our existing English-language library that is most relevant to European audiences, and bring it to market quickly.
• Manage translation partners and AI-assisted translation workflows, and act as the quality owner for French or German content, making sure tone, terminology and regulatory wording are right.
• Partner with Compliance to build a clear, efficient review process so content meets the requirements of each market without slowing us down.
• Project-manage the content workstream of the migration to our European website, including content inventory and audit, URL and content mapping, prioritisation, QA and launch checks, working with MarTech and the SEO Lead on technical delivery.
• Monitor and report on the search performance of European content, including rankings, organic traffic and conversions, and turn the findings into clear recommendations and priorities.
• Work with Marketing, Product and in-market stakeholders to make sure European content supports campaigns, launches and customer needs.
• Build clear documentation, templates and playbooks so the localisation process can scale across markets and languages.
• Find ways to help the team move faster and operate more strategically as a growth engine for IG. Curiosity with AI is a must.
What success looks like
• A clear, prioritised European content roadmap that stakeholders understand and support
• Migration content workstream delivered on time, with search visibility protected through the transition
• Measurable growth in organic traffic and conversions across priority European markets
• A well-documented, efficient localisation process with consistent quality and compliance sign-off
• High-quality French or German content that reads as if it was written locally
What you'll need for this role
• Fluent or native French or German, with excellent written and spoken English
• Proven experience in content, localisation, editorial or digital marketing roles, with a track record of delivering content at scale
• Strong project management skills, with experience delivering cross-functional projects to deadlines
• Commercial and data-led judgement, comfortable using performance data to prioritise and make decisions
• Strong stakeholder management and an ownership mindset, able to influence without direct authority
• Excellent attention to detail and the ability to deliver accurately at pace
• Curiosity about AI and how it can improve translation, content and reporting workflows
Nice to haves:
• Working knowledge of SEO, including keyword research, on-page optimisation and search performance reporting
• Experience with website migrations or replatforming
• Experience in financial services, fintech or another regulated industry
• Experience working with a CMS and with translation management tools or vendors
• Additional European languages, such as Spanish, Italian or Dutch
The perks:
It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. We work hybrid, which means three days in the office. We’ll recognise your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on.
• Competitive salary
• Flexible Benefits Package on top of your salary (12%)
• Private medical cover for you and your family
• Life insurance
• Contribution to gym memberships
• 25 days holiday, with 1 additional day off to celebrate your Birthday & 2 additional days off a year for voluntary work (28 in total)
• The option to buy or sell holiday days

We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.
About the Role:
Remitly's transaction monitoring program runs across our licensed jurisdictions and more than 170 receive countries, against a product set that keeps growing. Every new license, product, corridor, and rail changes what has to be monitored, and every regulator we answer to has its own expectations about how.
This role owns the intellectual center of that program: the policy, the standards behind the procedures, and the coverage methodology that determines which financial crime typologies are monitored, how, and to what standard, worldwide. You are accountable for the answer to the question every examiner eventually asks, which is how Remitly knows its monitoring covers the risk it actually has. You do not run the investigative queues. You define what the queues are looking for and prove the coverage holds as the business, the regulations, and the threat all move.
You Will:
Policy and standards
- Own the global transaction monitoring policy and the standards governing scenario design, thresholds, tuning, model validation, documentation, and change control.
- Set the procedural standards that regional and operational teams execute against, and oversee local variations required by jurisdictional obligations without fragmenting the global program.
- Maintain the control documentation and evidence set that demonstrates the program's design and operating effectiveness to examiners, auditors, and partner bank due diligence.
Coverage methodology
- Own Remitly's transaction monitoring coverage methodology: the framework that maps financial crime typologies to products, geographies, channels, and rails, and establishes what constitutes adequate coverage for each.
- Maintain the coverage assessment as a living artifact, with defensible rationale for what is in scope, what is out, and why.
- Identify and quantify coverage gaps and false negative exposure, prioritize them against risk, and drive remediation to closure with accountable owners.
- Direct scenario strategy: what gets built, retired, retuned, or replaced, and on what evidence.
Signal intake and response
- Establish the intake process that captures signals from regulators, examinations, partner banks, regional compliance teams, the strategic investigations function, and industry bodies, and converts them into coverage decisions.
- Own the assessment of regulatory change for monitoring impact, and drive the resulting scenario, threshold, and procedural changes on a schedule that meets the obligation.
- Assess new products, corridors, payment rails, and partner arrangements for monitoring implications before launch, and set the coverage requirements they must meet.
- Respond to emerging typologies and industry risk intelligence with concrete changes to detection rather than acknowledgment.
Effectiveness and assurance
- Define and operate the metrics that demonstrate whether monitoring is effective, not just operating: alert quality, escalation and conversion rates, scenario yield, tuning outcomes, and reporting quality.
- Own the tuning and optimization cycle, including the analytical basis for threshold changes and the documentation that makes them defensible.
- Partner with Compliance Assurance, Internal Audit, and model risk on testing and validation, and own remediation of findings.
- Report program health, coverage posture, and material gaps to the Chief Compliance Officer, executive leadership, and board-level oversight.
Partnership and delivery
- Partner with Data Science, Engineering, and Product to build and deploy detection, including where machine learning models are used, and set the governance around model use, explainability, and validation in a monitoring context.
- Work with the global operations organization to ensure scenario intent is understood and reflected in investigative outcomes, and use those outcomes as evidence in tuning.
- Work with Regional Compliance Officers to ensure the global framework satisfies local obligations and that local intelligence flows back into coverage.
- Represent the monitoring program to regulators, examiners, partner banks, and auditors.
Team
- Lead and develop the monitoring policy, coverage methodology, scenario strategy, and oversee tuning.
- Build the standards, documentation discipline, and analytical rigor that make the program repeatable rather than dependent on individuals.
You Have:
• 10+ years in financial crime compliance, with deep transaction monitoring ownership at a global financial institution, payments company, or fintech.
• Demonstrated ownership of a monitoring coverage methodology or risk coverage framework, including the ability to defend scope decisions to a regulator.
• Strong command of financial crime typologies across AML, sanctions, and fraud, and how they manifest differently by product, geography, and payment rail.
• Hands-on analytical capability. You can interrogate the data behind a threshold decision yourself, with SQL or equivalent, and you understand tuning statistics well enough to challenge them.
• Experience with monitoring technology and with model-based detection, including model governance, validation, and the limits of explainability.
• Track record operating a monitoring program under regulatory examination in multiple jurisdictions, and owning the resulting findings through closure.
• Experience translating regulatory change and new product launches into monitoring requirements on a deadline.
• Executive-grade written and verbal communication, with the credibility to hold a position under examiner pressure.
• Experience leading and building teams.

Job Title
Senior Payments Specialist
Job Description
So, who are we?
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.
The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.
Join us at IG – the future gets built here.
Your role in the Team’s Success:
We are hiring a 12 month FTC on a full time basis, Hybrid in London.
This Senior Payments Specialist will be a senior individual contributor within the Payment Operations team, responsible for maintaining and improving payment processes, supporting audits and control assurance, and managing the performance metrics that measure operational health across payment operations.
The role combines deep payments subject matter expertise with a continuous-improvement mindset, ensuring payment journeys are accurate, efficient, well controlled and compliant, while acting as a trusted point of reference for colleagues across operations, technology, product, customer experience and risk.
What you’ll do
Process ownership, maintenance and improvement
• Maintain, document and continuously improve core payment processes across deposits, withdrawals, reconciliations, client verification and payment investigations.
• Identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks and points of client friction, and design and implement process improvements.
• Keep standard operating procedures, process maps and knowledge resources current, and provide operational guidance and second-line support to payment operations teams.
• Support the introduction of new payment methods, providers and products, ensuring processes are operationally ready ahead of launch.
Audit, controls and governance
• Support internal and external audits, assurance reviews and regulatory examinations, including preparing evidence, walkthroughs and control documentation.
• Own and operate key payment operations controls, and design and implement control enhancements arising from audit and risk findings.
• Ensure processes remain compliant with applicable regulatory, financial crime and internal policy requirements.
• Contribute to risk assessments and maintain a clear, well-evidenced control environment.
Performance metrics and reporting
• Define, track and report on key performance indicators and service levels across payment operations, such as processing times, success and failure rates, backlog levels, reconciliation breaks, cost per transaction and fraud losses.
• Build and maintain dashboards and management information that give clear visibility of operational performance.
• Analyse performance trends, identify areas of underperformance or emerging risk, and drive corrective action with the relevant teams.
• Provide regular, accurate performance reporting to operational leadership and wider stakeholders.
Fraud, risk and quality
• Monitor payment activity for fraud indicators and operational risk, and help strengthen preventative controls.
• Conduct quality and control reviews, ensuring transactions are processed accurately and in line with policy.
• Investigate operational incidents and errors, identify root causes and implement preventative measures.
Automation and transformation
• Identify and progress opportunities to automate manual activity and increase straight-through processing.
• Partner with technology and product teams on tooling, self-service and system improvements that improve efficiency and client outcomes.
Stakeholder management
• Work closely with customer experience, product, technology, finance, compliance, fraud and regional operations teams.
• Act as the operational point of contact for payment-related projects and initiatives.
• Translate operational needs into practical, well-controlled solutions.
What you’ll need for this role
• Substantial experience in payment operations within financial services or a comparable regulated environment.
• Strong knowledge of payment processes across deposits, withdrawals, reconciliations, verification and investigations.
• Demonstrable experience supporting audits and owning or remediating operational controls.
• Proven ability to define and manage performance metrics, with strong analytical and data skills and confidence working with reporting and business-intelligence tools.
• Track record of process improvement and, ideally, automation or transformation delivery.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
• Methodical, detail-focused and able to balance business-as-usual delivery with change and improvement.
What success looks like
• Payment processes are well documented, efficient and continuously improving.
• Audits and control reviews are well supported, with findings remediated on time.
• Operational performance is clearly measured, reported and improving against agreed metrics.
• Fraud and operational risk are effectively controlled.
• Manual effort is reduced through automation and better tooling.
How we work
We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. We work hybrid, which means three days in the office.
Own the ambiguity: You'll work through it without a playbook, and get real ownership over how you solve it — excellence isn't optional here, it's the standard you hold yourself to.
Question everything: Curiosity is our currency — question what exists, and you'll have the platform to define what comes next.
Deliver at pace: The pace is real, but so is the momentum: deliver at speed, unpick hard problems, and help define the future of fintech.
Raise the bar: Take your craft seriously, and you'll be surrounded by people who take theirs just as seriously — that's the legacy you're building on, and adding to.
The perks
It really is more than a job. We’ll recognise your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on.
• Competitive salary
• Flexible Benefits Package on top of your salary (12%)
• Private medical cover for you and your family
• Life insurance
• Contribution to gym memberships
• 25 Days holiday, with 1 additional day off to celebrate your Birthday & 2 additional days off a year for voluntary work (28 in total)
• The option to buy or sell holiday days
• Unlimited access to the LinkedIn Learning Platform
• A comprehensive global and local onboarding process
• Employee-led LGBTQ+, Women’s, Black and Parents & Carers networks with an annual budget for organising events & projects…

Job Description:
The opportunity:
Leonardo offers a range of Apprenticeships from 2-5yrs. across a variety of STEM and business routes, offering paid training, coupled with on the job learning that enables you to gain practical skills, experience and knowledge that sets up the best start to your career. We offer competitive entry salaries and fully support your academic learning through to qualifications, with salary increases as you progress.
We support helping you settle into your new location ensuring you are familiar with the team and have a warm welcome from day 1. There is a member of our Apprentice team at each site, helping you progress, ensuring your study time is protected, enabling access to digital learning as well as opportunities to get involved with the local community and STEM projects, enhance many aspects of each programme.
Programme Description
You will be working within world class facilities. During your apprenticeship, you may be working in an office or lab environment or a combination of both.
How this role fits in Leonardo’s four-year Manufacturing Technical Apprenticeship provides a wealth of learning and development opportunities including an HND in Engineering systems, SVQ level 2 (PEO) and a vocational Diploma in Engineering SCQF Level 7. Working with world-leading specialists, you will increase your technical skills and capability, and develop your academic and practical understanding of the engineering lifecycle.
You will undertake a series of rotational placements which could include the methods of testing industry leading radar and laser systems – covering Electronic Testing; Laser Testing; Radar Testing; Legacy Product Testing; Manufacturing Engineering. These placements are to give a broad range of operational experience but may not all be hiring.
During the rotational placements you will learn how to test complex electrical and mechanical systems to ensure they are safe and reliable. An example of this could be within our state-of-the-art environmental test facility where you will be testing systems under various environmental conditions including altitude, temperature, humidity and vibration. In other departments you could be office based, looking at our manufacturing processes and how they can be refined to reduce cost, or improve build quality. The rotational placement plan will truly give you a flavour of all aspects of engineering verification and test.
Key Responsibility Areas
Years 1 and 2:
During your first five months you will be attending college full-time to complete an SVQ Level 2. Once back on-site, you will conduct rotational placements where you will gather real work evidence such as written logs describing day-to-day tasks completed and highlighting the key engineering competencies you have demonstrated. The SVQ  will require you to complete a folder of this evidence, demonstrating your development into a well-rounded technician/engineer through on-the-job training and are gaining the essential practical skills to succeed. During this time you will also be attending college on day release to gain the academic qualifications required by the Apprenticeship framework.
Years 3 and 4:
Having gained broad experience across Leonardo, you will undertake a final placement and further your academic study to HND level. These activities will be focused on your area of specialism and the on-the-job training will enable you to gather the final evidence required for the SVQ. Beyond the programme there may be the opportunity for you to further your academic achievements based on your talents and capability and needs of the business.
Who would suit this role?
Leonardo values people that look to always develop throughout their career and along with an eager willingness to learn, a successful apprenticeship with Leonardo involves a drive to deliver results, sometimes from your own initiative, patience and problem solving as well as a need to comply with safety and process compliance at all times.
We also view dependability to the programme and learning objectives very highly.
Requirements
Skills, Qualifications & Knowledge Required
You must have (as a minimum) the following academic qualifications:
•3 x Higher Grades (or equivalent):
•Mandatory: Mathematics (A-C) and Physics (A-C) or Engineering Science (A–C)
•Plus Another Higher subject, preferably a technological subject e.g. Graphic Communication, Product Design, Craft & Design, Tech Studies, Computing etc. (A-C)
•Standard Grades (1-3) / National 5: (A-C) English – minimum Nat 5 A-C
Note: This Apprenticeship assumes the candidate has little engineering knowledge and is NOT suitable for candidates who already have an HNC
Salary: £21,000
Security Clearance
At Leonardo, many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations.  As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years.
For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV).  As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment.
To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years.  In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.  Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment.
For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting
Why join us
At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do, key contributors in shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety.
We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive.

Working collaboratively across education, health, social care and wider partners, you will lead strategic developments that strengthen inclusion, improve outcomes and ensure children, young people and families are at the heart of decision-making.
As SEND Reform & Inclusion Lead, you will provide strategic leadership for Hull's innovative Experts at Hand offer, oversee the effective deployment of significant SEND Reform investment, and drive the delivery of a financially sustainable and inclusive local SEND system.

Working with schools, academies, early years providers, colleges, commissioners and wider partners, you will champion inclusion across the city and lead the implementation of national SEND reforms locally.
You will be responsible for delivering Hull's three-year SEND Reform Delivery Plan, ensuring progress is monitored, partners are held to account and improvements result in tangible benefits for children and young people with SEND. You will oversee the management of the multi-million-pound SEND Reform Grant, ensuring investment delivers value for money and contributes to the development of a sustainable SEND system.
A key aspect of the role will be leading Hull's Experts at Hand offer, ensuring resources are deployed fairly, transparently and according to need. You will promote approaches that build inclusive capability within mainstream settings and support schools to meet the needs of children and young people closer to home.
Working directly with Headteachers, Trust Leaders, SENCOs and governing bodies, you will support the improvement of SEND provision across the city. You will lead SEND Inclusion Audits, using evidence to identify strengths, areas for development and emerging trends. You will also take responsibility for Local Area SEND inspection readiness, maintaining Hull's Self-Evaluation Framework (SEF) and ensuring that inspection findings and peer review outcomes drive continuous improvement.
You will line manage the commissioning team manager in Children’s Services to ensure that evidence, the principles of co-production and value for money shape services.

• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence and challenge constructively at all levels

• The ability to translate strategy into practical action and deliver measurable outcomes

Hull is a city on the rise: ambitious, affordable and proud of its strong sense of community. Situated on the banks of the Humber with easy access to stunning coastline and countryside, Hull offers an excellent quality of life, affordable housing, outstanding cultural and leisure opportunities, and a commitment to making a real difference for children and families.
This is an exciting time to join Hull Children's Services, which has recently achieved its strongest ever Ofsted outcome through the ILACS framework, being rated Good overall with Outstanding features. Inspectors recognised sustained improvement, strong leadership, effective partnership working and exceptional support for care leavers, highlighting services that are helping children and families to thrive.
Joining Hull means becoming part of a high-performing, values-driven organisation that is ambitious for its workforce and determined to deliver the very best outcomes for children and young people with SEND.
This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of SEND provision across the city. Working at the heart of Hull's SEND Reform Programme, you will influence strategy, drive system-wide improvement and strengthen inclusive practice across schools, settings and services.
If you are an ambitious and collaborative leader with the credibility to inspire partners, challenge effectively and deliver meaningful change, we would love to hear from you. Together, we can create a more inclusive education system where every child and young person can thrive.
ROLE AND PURPOSE
Working collaboratively with schools, academies, early years providers, post-16 settings and wider partners, the post holder will champion inclusion and support the implementation of national SEND reforms in Hull. They will provide strategic leadership of the city’s Experts at Hand offer and will closely monitor the multi-million SEND Reform grant so that it contributes to the delivery of a financially sustainable SEND system.
The post-holder will ensure that parents, carers and young people are meaningfully engaged in shaping services and will work with commissioners to monitor the impact of these on the experiences and outcomes of young people with SEND. When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.
Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.
About Parexel
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart®.
About the Role
We are seeking a Study Physician (Medical Monitor, Clinical Development Physician) to join our team in a remote capacity. As a Study Physician, you will provide medical leadership and oversight across the preparation, conduct, and reporting phases of global clinical trials. This role is critical to ensuring patient safety, scientific integrity, regulatory compliance, and high-quality clinical trial execution.
As a core member of cross-functional trial teams, you will collaborate closely with clinical development, operations, safety, data management, and medical writing colleagues to deliver medically robust studies that support the advancement of innovative therapies. You will contribute to protocol development, risk-based quality management, clinical data review, study documentation, investigator engagement, and regulatory interactions while helping ensure the highest standards of medical oversight throughout the trial lifecycle.
You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment where your medical expertise will directly influence study quality, patient safety, and clinical development outcomes. Working alongside global teams, you will have the opportunity to apply your clinical experience in complex international trials while contributing to research that improves patient lives.
Key Responsibilities
·         Provide medical leadership for clinical trials from protocol development through clinical study report completion
·         Develop and review medical content within Clinical Trial Protocols and contribute to protocol updates as needed
·         Contribute to risk-based quality management by identifying medically relevant critical data, risks, and mitigation strategies
·         Provide medical input into Clinical Quality Monitoring Plans, important protocol deviation assessments, and clinical quality activities
·         Perform ongoing medical review of aggregated clinical trial data, identify risks and quality issues, and support timely mitigation and escalation activities
·         Contribute medical expertise to key study documents including eCRF design, Data Review Plans, informed consent documents, monitoring manuals, communication plans, training plans, and statistical analysis plans
·         Support preparation of patient narratives and review medical content of Clinical Trial Reports
·         Respond to medical questions from investigators, CRO partners, and sponsor representatives while maintaining high standards of medical expertise
·         Provide medical input into study feasibility, patient recruitment, retention strategies, and site engagement activities
·         Support interactions with Ethics Committees, Institutional Review Boards, Data Monitoring Committees, Data Safety Monitoring Boards, Steering Committees, and regulatory authorities as applicable
·         Deliver medical training for investigators, study teams, and sponsor personnel
·         Contribute to trial communications, newsletters, and scientific publications where applicable
Candidate Profile
You’ll thrive in this role if you bring:
·         Strengths in medical assessment, clinical trial oversight, risk-based quality management, and cross-functional collaboration
·         Experience working in clinical research, pharmaceutical development, or a regulated healthcare environment
·         The ability to build relationships across global teams and communicate complex medical information clearly
·         A patient-focused mindset and commitment to scientific excellence and quality
·         Comfort working with clinical trial systems, data visualization tools, and digital technologies that support clinical development activities
Required Qualifications
